svg.title: Bloch phases differ while the site probabilities remain equal
svg.desc: Two normalized eigenvectors of a periodic four-site nearest-neighbor tight-binding chain have coefficients c_j=exp(i k j a)/2. The site labels are j=0,1,2,3. Each small coordinate frame is a complex plane, with the real axis right and imaginary axis up. Its arrow is the complex number 2 c_j, not a position, momentum or particle trajectory. For ka=0 all arrows point right and the energy is zero. For ka=pi/2 the arrows point right, up, left and down and the energy is 2t_h. Every site has probability one quarter in both states. The diagonal energy is epsilon0=2t_h.
svg.text: Bloch phase changes without changing the site probabilities
(b) Phase advances by π/2 per site
